description_en: Creates a tag for a resource
description_zh: 针对一个资源，创建一个标签
kebab_example: aliyun paielasticdatasetaccelerator create-tag --resource-type Instance --resource-id inst-my1tk3jggooi5uwks --key dataset_version --value v0.1.0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateTag

parameters.description_en:
The type of resource to which the tag belongs. Valid values:

- Instance: Dataset acceleration instance.

- Slot: Dataset acceleration slot.
parameters.description_zh:
标签所属的资源的类型，取值如下：
- Instance：数据集加速实例。
- Slot：数据集加速槽。

parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.description_en:
The ID of the resource to which the tag belongs.

- If ResourceType is Instance, set it to the dataset acceleration instance ID. For more information about how to obtain the acceleration instance ID, see [ListInstances](~~467899~~).

- If ResourceType is Slot, set it to the dataset acceleration slot ID. For more information about how to obtain the dataset acceleration slot ID, see [ListSlots](~~467905~~).
parameters.description_zh:
标签所属的资源的ID。
- 当ResourceType为Instance时，需要配置为数据集加速实例ID，如何获取加速实例ID，请参见[ListInstances](~~467899~~)。
- 当ResourceType为Slot时，需要配置为数据集加速槽ID，如何获取数据集加速槽ID，请参见[ListSlots](~~467905~~)。
